LAM.1.1.text: She who was great among the nations

LAM.1.2.text: She weeps aloud in the night,
there is no one to comfort her.
All her friends have betrayed her;

LAM.1.3.text: but finds no place to rest.
All her pursuers have overtaken her
in the midst of her distress.

LAM.1.4.text: because no one comes to her appointed feasts.
and she herself is bitter with anguish.

LAM.1.5.text: Her foes have become her masters;
For the LORD has brought her grief

LAM.1.6.text: they lack the strength to flee
in the face of the hunter.

LAM.1.7.text: In the days of her affliction and wandering
that were hers in days of old.
When her people fell into enemy hands

LAM.1.8.text: therefore she has become an object of scorn.
All who honored her now despise her,
for they have seen her nakedness;
she herself groans and turns away.

LAM.1.9.text: she did not consider her end.
there was no one to comfort her.
Look, O LORD, on my affliction,

LAM.1.10.text: For she has seen the nations

LAM.1.11.text: They have traded their treasures for food

LAM.1.12.text: Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by?
Is there any sorrow like mine,
which the LORD made me suffer
on the day of His fierce anger?

LAM.1.13.text: He sent fire from on high,
He spread a net for my feet

LAM.1.14.text: My transgressions are bound into a yoke,
they are draped over my neck,
and the Lord has broken my strength.
He has delivered me into the hands

LAM.1.15.text: all the mighty men in my midst;
He has summoned an army against me
the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.

LAM.1.16.text: For there is no one nearby to comfort me,
no one to revive my soul.

LAM.1.17.text: but there is no one to comfort her.
The LORD has decreed against Jacob
that his neighbors become his foes.

LAM.1.18.text: for I have rebelled against His command.

LAM.1.19.text: I called out to my lovers,

LAM.1.20.text: See, O LORD, how distressed I am!
my heart is pounding within me,
for I have been most rebellious.

LAM.1.21.text: but there is no one to comfort me.
All my enemies have heard of my trouble;
they are glad that You have caused it.
May You bring the day You have announced,
so that they may become like me.

LAM.1.22.text: Let all their wickedness come before You,
as You have dealt with me

LAM.2.1.text: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion
with the cloud of His anger!
He has cast the glory of Israel
in the day of His anger.

LAM.2.2.text: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up
In His wrath He has demolished
the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah.
He brought to the ground and defiled

LAM.2.3.text: In fierce anger He has cut off
at the approach of the enemy.
He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire

LAM.2.4.text: He has bent His bow like an enemy;
Like a foe He has killed
all who were pleasing to the eye;
He has poured out His wrath like fire
on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.

LAM.2.5.text: The Lord is like an enemy;
He has swallowed up all her palaces
He has multiplied mourning and lamentation

LAM.2.6.text: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth;
He has destroyed His place of meeting.
The LORD has made Zion forget
He has despised both king and priest.

LAM.2.7.text: The Lord has rejected His altar;
He has delivered the walls of her palaces
into the hand of the enemy.
They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD
as on the day of an appointed feast.

LAM.2.8.text: the wall of the Daughter of Zion.
He stretched out a measuring line
and did not withdraw His hand from destroying.
He made the ramparts and walls lament;

LAM.2.9.text: Her gates have sunk into the ground;
He has destroyed and shattered their bars.
Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations,
find no vision from the LORD.

LAM.2.10.text: The elders of the Daughter of Zion
sit on the ground in silence.
They have thrown dust on their heads
have bowed their heads to the ground.

LAM.2.11.text: My heart is poured out in grief
over the destruction of the daughter of my people,
in the streets of the city.

LAM.2.12.text: They cry out to their mothers:
as they faint like the wounded
in the streets of the city,
in the arms of their mothers.

LAM.2.13.text: What can I say for you?
To what can I compare you,
To what can I liken you,
For your wound is as deep as the sea.

LAM.2.14.text: they did not expose your guilt
The burdens they envisioned for you

LAM.2.15.text: clap their hands at you in scorn.
They hiss and shake their heads
“Is this the city that was called
the joy of all the earth?”

LAM.2.16.text: They hiss and gnash their teeth,
This is the day for which we have waited.
We have lived to see it!”

LAM.2.17.text: The LORD has done what He planned;
which He ordained in days of old;
He has overthrown you without pity.
He has let the enemy gloat over you
and exalted the horn of your foes.

LAM.2.18.text: O wall of the Daughter of Zion,
let your tears run down like a river

LAM.2.19.text: Arise, cry out in the night
from the first watch of the night.
Pour out your heart like water
in the presence of the Lord.
Lift up your hands to Him
for the lives of your children
on the corner of every street.

LAM.2.20.text: Whom have You ever treated like this?
Should priests and prophets be killed
in the sanctuary of the Lord?

LAM.2.21.text: Both young and old lie together
in the dust of the streets.
You have slain them in the day of Your anger;
You have slaughtered them without compassion.

LAM.2.22.text: You summoned my attackers on every side,
as for the day of an appointed feast.
In the day of the LORD’s anger

LAM.3.1.text: I am the man who has seen affliction
under the rod of God’s wrath.

LAM.3.2.text: He has driven me away and made me walk

LAM.3.3.text: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand

LAM.3.4.text: He has worn away my flesh and skin;

LAM.3.5.text: He has besieged me and surrounded me

LAM.3.6.text: He has made me dwell in darkness

LAM.3.7.text: He has walled me in so I cannot escape;
He has weighed me down with chains.

LAM.3.8.text: Even when I cry out and plead for help,

LAM.3.9.text: He has barred my ways with cut stones;
He has made my paths crooked.

LAM.3.10.text: He is a bear lying in wait,

LAM.3.11.text: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces;

LAM.3.12.text: and set me as the target for His arrow.

LAM.3.14.text: I am a laughingstock to all my people;
they mock me in song all day long.

LAM.3.15.text: He has filled me with bitterness;
He has intoxicated me with wormwood.

LAM.3.16.text: He has ground my teeth with gravel
and trampled me in the dust.

LAM.3.17.text: My soul has been deprived of peace;
I have forgotten what prosperity is.

LAM.3.18.text: So I say, “My strength has perished,
along with my hope from the LORD.”

LAM.3.21.text: Yet I call this to mind,

LAM.3.22.text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed,

LAM.3.24.text: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul,

LAM.3.25.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him,
to the soul who seeks Him.

LAM.3.26.text: It is good to wait quietly
for the salvation of the LORD.

LAM.3.27.text: It is good for a man to bear the yoke

LAM.3.28.text: Let him sit alone in silence,

LAM.3.29.text: Let him bury his face in the dust—

LAM.3.30.text: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him;
let him be filled with reproach.

LAM.3.32.text: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion
according to His abundant loving devotion.

LAM.3.33.text: For He does not willingly afflict
or grieve the sons of men.

LAM.3.34.text: all the prisoners of the land,

LAM.3.36.text: to subvert a man in his lawsuit—
of these the Lord does not approve.

LAM.3.37.text: Who has spoken and it came to pass,
unless the Lord has ordained it?

LAM.3.38.text: Do not both adversity and good
come from the mouth of the Most High?

LAM.3.39.text: Why should any mortal man complain,

LAM.3.40.text: Let us examine and test our ways,
and turn back to the LORD.

LAM.3.41.text: Let us lift up our hearts and hands

LAM.3.43.text: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us;

LAM.3.44.text: You have covered Yourself with a cloud
that no prayer can pass through.

LAM.3.45.text: You have made us scum and refuse

LAM.3.47.text: Panic and pitfall have come upon us—

LAM.3.48.text: Streams of tears flow from my eyes
over the destruction of the daughter of my people.

LAM.3.50.text: looks down from heaven and sees.

LAM.3.51.text: My eyes bring grief to my soul
because of all the daughters of my city.

LAM.3.53.text: They dropped me alive into a pit

LAM.3.54.text: The waters flowed over my head,
and I thought I was going to die.

LAM.3.55.text: I called on Your name, O LORD,
out of the depths of the Pit.

LAM.3.56.text: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”

LAM.3.57.text: You drew near when I called on You;

LAM.3.58.text: You defend my cause, O Lord;

LAM.3.59.text: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me;

LAM.3.60.text: You have seen all their malice,

LAM.3.61.text: O LORD, You have heard their insults,

LAM.3.62.text: the slander and murmuring of my assailants

LAM.3.63.text: When they sit and when they rise,
see how they mock me in song.

LAM.3.64.text: You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD,
according to the work of their hands.

LAM.3.65.text: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts;
may Your curse be upon them!

LAM.3.66.text: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them
from under Your heavens, O LORD.

LAM.4.1.text: How the gold has become tarnished,
the pure gold has become dull!
The gems of the temple lie scattered

LAM.4.2.text: How the precious sons of Zion,
once worth their weight in pure gold,
are now esteemed as jars of clay,
the work of a potter’s hands!

LAM.4.3.text: but the daughter of my people has become cruel,
like an ostrich in the wilderness.

LAM.4.4.text: clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth.
but no one gives them any.

LAM.4.6.text: The punishment of the daughter of my people
is greater than that of Sodom,
which was overthrown in an instant
without a hand turned to help her.

LAM.4.7.text: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow,
their bodies were more ruddy than rubies,

LAM.4.8.text: But now their appearance is blacker than soot;
they are not recognized in the streets.
Their skin has shriveled on their bones;
it has become as dry as a stick.

LAM.4.9.text: Those slain by the sword are better off
than those who die of hunger,
who waste away, pierced with pain

LAM.4.10.text: in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

LAM.4.11.text: The LORD has exhausted His wrath;
He has poured out His fierce anger;
He has kindled a fire in Zion,
and it has consumed her foundations.

LAM.4.12.text: The kings of the earth did not believe,
nor any people of the world,
that an enemy or a foe
could enter the gates of Jerusalem.

LAM.4.13.text: But this was for the sins of her prophets
and the guilt of her priests,
who shed the blood of the righteous

LAM.4.14.text: They wandered blind in the streets,

LAM.4.15.text: Among the nations it was said,

LAM.4.16.text: The presence of the LORD has scattered them;
The priests are shown no honor;

LAM.4.17.text: All the while our eyes were failing
as we looked in vain for help.
for a nation that could not save us.

LAM.4.18.text: so that we could not walk in our streets.
Our end drew near, our time ran out,

LAM.4.19.text: Those who chased us were swifter
than the eagles in the sky;
they pursued us over the mountains
and ambushed us in the wilderness.

LAM.4.20.text: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life,
“Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”

LAM.4.21.text: So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom,
you who dwell in the land of Uz.
Yet the cup will pass to you as well;
you will get drunk and expose yourself.

LAM.4.22.text: O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete;
He will not prolong your exile.
But He will punish your iniquity, O Daughter of Edom;

LAM.5.1.text: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us.

LAM.5.2.text: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,

LAM.5.4.text: We must buy the water we drink;
our wood comes at a price.

LAM.5.5.text: we are weary and find no rest.

LAM.5.6.text: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria

LAM.5.7.text: Our fathers sinned and are no more,

LAM.5.8.text: there is no one to deliver us from their hands.

LAM.5.9.text: We get our bread at the risk of our lives
because of the sword in the wilderness.

LAM.5.10.text: Our skin is as hot as an oven

LAM.5.11.text: Women have been ravished in Zion,
virgins in the cities of Judah.

LAM.5.12.text: Princes have been hung up by their hands;

LAM.5.13.text: boys stagger under loads of wood.

LAM.5.14.text: The elders have left the city gate;
the young men have stopped their music.

LAM.5.15.text: our dancing has turned to mourning.

LAM.5.16.text: The crown has fallen from our head.
Woe to us, for we have sinned!

LAM.5.17.text: Because of this, our hearts are faint;
because of these, our eyes grow dim—

LAM.5.18.text: because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate,

LAM.5.19.text: Your throne endures from generation to generation.

LAM.5.20.text: Why have You forgotten us forever?
Why have You forsaken us for so long?

LAM.5.21.text: Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return;
renew our days as of old,

LAM.5.22.text: unless You have utterly rejected us
and remain angry with us beyond measure.
